title: The signed splice identity for the concrete class
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with derived Ext [def-pc-ext]. Let $n\ge0$, let $S$ be a short exact complex, let $F$ be a degree-$n+1$ extension of $U$ by $S.X_3$, and let $E$ be a degree-$n+2$ extension of $U$ by $S.X_1$, with splice data [def-coef-yoneda-extension-data] identifying $E$ with the splice of $S$ and $F$. The concrete classes [def-coef-yoneda-recursive-class] satisfy $\delta(E)=(-1)^n(\delta(F)\mathbin{\mathrm{comp}}\operatorname{extClass}(S))$.

source.place: Tags 06XU and 06XV, Yoneda composition and the shifted positive-projection sign

proof.text: Descend firstIso.hom followed by the actual cokernel projection through the epimorphism S.g, obtaining q. Form a morphism S to E.head with components leftIso.inv, firstIso.hom, q. The splice square gives a morphism F.sequence to E.tail.sequence with components F.leftIso.hom followed by q and tailIso.hom. Its endpoint maps are q and the identity of U. Apply derivedClass_naturality to this morphism and extClass_naturality to the head morphism. Unfold the recursive class, reassociate Ext composition, and cancel the inverse endpoint isomorphisms. The factor (-1)^n is the common defining sign.

theorem derivedClass_splice (U : A) (n : ℕ) (S : ShortComplex A) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (F : YonedaExtension A S.X₃ U (n + 1))
    (E : YonedaExtension A S.X₁ U (n + 2)) (s : Splice S F E) :
    E.derivedClass (n + 1) =
      (-1 : ℤ) ^ n • ((F.derivedClass n).comp hS.extClass (by omega))
